text:
rebecca-people: Quick Q from Santosh's team. Olivia had an unexpected medical leave in Nov and couldn't use 3 PTO days. Her contract year ends Dec 31 and the year-end blackout is Dec 20-31. Manager asked whether we can carry those 3 days over into next year or pay them out.

olivia-engineering: Hi — I had surgery in Nov so couldn't take the days. I still have paperwork from my doctor. Would prefer to carry because I'll be taking an extended training in Jan.

santosh-manager: Manager note: team is short coverage during blackout so I wanted to check policy before approving anything. If carryover isn't allowed, could payroll do a one-time payout?

rebecca-people: Policy refresher: standard PTO carryover applies to employees (not contractors) and is capped per policy (see handbook). Carryover requests that interact with the year-end blackout are allowed but need People Ops + Manager approval. Medical leave itself doesn't change PTO carryover caps; however if time was medically necessary (FMLA/medical leave), we treat those days according to medical leave rules — sometimes converted to leave without using PTO.

hr-bot: Automated note: Employee Olivia (emp_id 84201) has a medical accommodation on file from 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-20. Please attach documentation to People Ops ticket.

jon-payroll: For payout: payroll can process a lump-sum PTO payout if carryover is denied, but payout requires manager approval + People Ops sign-off and must be processed before fiscal close. We need the payroll CSV:

worker_id, action, days, pay_code, note
84201, PTO_PAYOUT, 3, PTO-PAY, "Nov medical unused PTO payout"

Send to payroll@redwood.com and cc rebecca-people.

rebecca-people: Steps I recommend: 1) Manager confirms intent in this thread (approve carryover or request payout). 2) Olivia attaches medical docs to the People Ops ticket. 3) If carryover chosen: I will file HR ticket to request exception for carryover cap (if needed). If payout chosen: manager emails payroll with CSV.

olivia-engineering: Confirming I'd like carryover if possible. I've uploaded the doctor's note to the HR portal and gave Santosh access.

santosh-manager: I approve carryover pending People Ops confirmation. Team coverage will be managed via rotations; not an issue.

rebecca-people: Thanks. I'll file the People Ops ticket (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-2042) and mark as high priority due to year-end timing. Note: any carryover that exceeds the policy cap requires Finance approval for accrual accounting. If Finance denies, we'll trigger the payout path and payroll will need the CSV by 2026-12-18 to meet close.

jon-payroll: Noted. If we go carryover, please include expected fiscal impact in ticket: estimated payout amount if forced to pay out (so Finance can sign off).

hr-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout 2026-12-20 to 2026-12-31. All time-off during blackout requires manager + People Ops approval.

rebecca-people: Closing loop: I'll file the ticket now, assign to Finance for accrual exception, and update this thread when done. Olivia, thanks for uploading docs. :thumbsup:
